scope: GE-04 A03 independent re-review handoff after nonblocking recvmsg fix
source_patch:
diff --git a/native/ge04/bootstrap_receiver.py b/native/ge04/bootstrap_receiver.py
index e971abbf..33bdfa85 100644
--- a/native/ge04/bootstrap_receiver.py
+++ b/native/ge04/bootstrap_receiver.py
@@ -63,11 +63,12 @@ def receive_bootstrap_descriptor(sock, expected_peer, expected_inode,
             raise TimeoutError("Bootstrap receive budget exceeded")
         ready, _, _ = select.select([sock], [], [], remaining)
         if not ready:
             raise TimeoutError("Bootstrap receive deadline")
         payload, ancillary, flags, _ = sock.recvmsg(
-            2, socket.CMSG_SPACE(4 * 16), socket.MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC)
+            2, socket.CMSG_SPACE(4 * 16),
+            socket.MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC | socket.MSG_DONTWAIT)
         # Always first extract *all* kernel-delivered descriptors for closure,
         # including rejected extra or truncated ancillary records.
         for level, kind, data in ancillary:
             if level == socket.SOL_SOCKET and kind == socket.SCM_RIGHTS:
                 valid = len(data) - (len(data) % array.array("i").itemsize)
limitations: Source delta and local tests do not replace independent human review
No operational root execution, worker admission, ACK or merge authorized
Old immutable baseline checker must continue rejecting changed source until renewed review
